correctness.rationale: The independent edge coordinates make vanishing of the bracket equivalent to vanishing of all edge-column minors, also in characteristic two. On exact support, nonzero columns are proportional precisely as required along each component. A useful independent route to the transform is to count all bracket-compatible j-by-n matrices, not necessarily full rank: component line assignments and nonzero column choices give Q_G(q−1,[j]_q). For row space of dimension r there are ∏_{i<r}(q^j−q^i) matrix presentations, so these evaluations are also the triangular Gaussian transform of |GL_r|B_r. Subspace inversion gives (1), and the diagonal coefficient and distinct projective point counts give the fixed-q inverse. B₁ gives n, and infinitely many q−1 recover the coefficients in X. For the strata, fix a pivot vertex per support component and record each remaining coordinate ratio. This identifies the reduced stratum with a torus of dimension |S|−c times the open set of Gr(r,c) of r-planes with every coordinate active. It is nonempty iff c≥r and has dimension |S|−c+r(c−r). For the full algebra, lifting through the derived central space, not necessarily the full center, gives exactly the stated affine space of maps for each W and K and verifies (2). In P₅ the r=2 contributions by support are 6, 6(q−1), 3(q−1)² and (q+2)(q−1), giving 4q²+q+1; the only c≥3 support is the independent triple. At q=2 the lift sum 35+3720+4864 gives 8619. The tree collision and the odd-characteristic nonisomorphism implication match the cited propositions.
residual_risks: The geometric statement is about reduced strata, not nonreduced schemes or their closure components. Nonisomorphism is verified only in the cited odd-characteristic setting.
